app.name: Codex Onboarding
app.tagline: One guided path from environment check to a verified Codex / Claude Code setup

welcome.title: Welcome to Codex Onboarding
welcome.intro: This tool walks you through: checking your machine → installing what is missing → configuring the company gateway in CC Switch → verifying that everything works. No documentation required; when something fails you get the cause and the fix.

whatWeDoItems.check: Detects your OS, Node.js, Codex CLI, Claude Code, CC Switch, environment variables and network reachability
whatWeDoItems.install: Runs install commands only after you confirm, showing the exact command and live progress
whatWeDoItems.guide: Hands you the company gateway address and other standard values and guides you step by step inside CC Switch
whatWeDoItems.verify: Verifies the CLI in a fresh terminal session and sends one minimal test request to the gateway

whatWeDontItems.noConfigWrite: It never edits ~/.codex, ~/.claude or CC Switch configuration files
whatWeDontItems.noEnvEdit: It never changes your system environment variables (conflicts are reported for you to fix)
whatWeDontItems.noKeyStorage: It never stores or uploads your API key (the connectivity test uses it once, in memory)

welcome.telemetryNotice: To help IT improve the process, the tool can report anonymous step success rates and durations (no keys, URLs or personal data).

done.title: Setup complete
done.openTerminalHint: Open a new terminal window and run {{command}} to get started.
done.helpHint: If anything goes wrong later, run this tool again and use the diagnosis in the “Verify” step, or contact {{contact}}.
